5.5
Database Layer
The database layer is implemented using SQLAlchemy ORM.
Its responsibilities include:
• Creating database engine
• Managing database sessions
• ORM model mapping
• Automatic table creation
• Transaction management
SQLite is used for structured application data, while MongoDB stores uploaded re-
search documents.
5.6
Authentication Module
The authentication module provides secure access control using JWT authentication.
Major functionalities include:
• User Registration
• Login
• Password Hashing
• JWT Token Generation
• Session Validation
• Protected API Access
• Logout
Passwords are hashed using the bcrypt algorithm before storage, ensuring that plain-
text passwords are never stored in the database.
JWT tokens are generated after successful authentication and are attached to subse-
quent API requests for accessing protected resources.
